title: Strict deployment qualification gates
summary: Promotion requires real per-MI boot, FAST crypto, registration, heartbeat, named-service admission, authenticated execution/return and durable controller result, with reboot recovery verified.
invariants: F/H local MI connectivity is reported; 20/20 live work acceptance is still unproven.
The eight other MUs cannot be counted from SSH reachability or synthetic fixture results.
Separate L2 local, L3 raw36 and L4 UDP cross-cloud admission test coverage.
Fail closed on missing, duplicate, malformed, wrong-route, wrong-epoch, wrong-controller or uncommitted receipts.
Reboot persistence and WAN federation are not established merely by transient test units.

provenance.claim: Passed local Python and native tests; no live estate job
